commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking

echo "Running mypy type checking on Python files in src/..."

# Find all Python files in src/ and run mypy on them
mypy src/

# Check if mypy exited with non-zero status
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Type checking failed. Please fix the errors before committing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Type checking passed!"
exit 0
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on staged Python files

# Get list of staged Python files
STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.py$')

# If no Python files are staged, exit successfully
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

echo "Running mypy type checking on staged Python files..."

# Run mypy on the staged files
echo "$STAGED_FILES" | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 mypy

# Check if mypy exited with non-zero status
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Type checking failed. Please fix the errors before committing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Type checking passed!"
exit 0
EOF
